sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to menu

params.name: process
params.description: Process reference number; defaults to the current process if omitted.

overloads.semanticRole: Get the character code of the standard Ctrl (Windows) / Command (macOS) shortcut key assigned to a menu item.

constraints: If menu is a MenuRef (menu reference), the process parameter is unnecessary and is ignored if passed.
Returns 0 if the menu item has no associated shortcut, or if menuItem designates a hierarchical submenu.
